ns2:course.label: Intro to Radiation Protection
ns2:course.description: (NPRE 241) Introductory course in the elements of radiation protection and health physics, emphasizing practical applications. Same as ENVS 241. Seniors in nuclear engineering may not receive credit for NPRE 241. Prerequisite: MATH 220 or equivalent; a biology, chemistry, or physics course; or consent of instructor.
